newsitem.title: UK: Air Canadian Oct cargo traffic just above Sept.
newsitem.headline: Air Canadian Oct cargo traffic just above Sept.

text.p: Canadian Airlines carried 44.8 million cargo-tonne miles (CTM) in October or 1.2 million more than September and level with October last year, the carrier said in a statement received here.
During October freight CTMs totalled 43.2 million while airmail CTMs were 1.7 million.

Canadian Air Cargo has re-introduced its XMS product on most domestic routes from December 1 to December 21 giving flat pricing of C$25 for any shipment upto 10 kilos with a targhet of second day delivery to destination, the statement added. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+44 171 542-5017
